reviews.title: Do not support their customers
reviews.text:
I was excited to use the Agoda app - I heard they had more properties in Asia and was tired of booking.com and Airbnb. 

Be careful!! I’ve lost over $4k on a booking with Agoda. The only way to get a total is to put a booking in your cart to total it.  Properties will have a base rate but sneak in higher rates for certain days.  It looks better but once you total it’s more expensive. If you don’t remove it from your cart Agoda will send you notifications that it will sell out. In my case I made a booking for a hotel on Agoda and didn’t see the email confirmation. Then was prompted by an Agoda notification to book the other booking in my cart with a very similar name.  I panicked thinking my original booking didn’t go thru and made the reservation.  The reservation was for the same dates and overlapped by a week.  How can I be in two places at once? I immediately lwithin the hour contacted Agoda by phone, WhatsApp and the app. I also reached out to the property directly. 


The reality is Agoda does not support their customers. They support the hotels and rentals. I have been trying to resolve an issue for over two months and over 20 hours of my time. They do not have consistent policies, they try to discredit me as a customer and use tactics to dissuade you.  No follow ups and no support. You are better off sticking with other services.

reviews.text:
No Flight Updates: Booked via Agoda, but received zero updates (app or email) when the return flight was delayed and cancelled on 19 Sep.

Left in the Dark: Unlike passengers from other platforms, Agoda customers received no notifications and were completely clueless about refund or rescheduling options.

Absurd Rescheduling: Contacted live chat on 22 Sep (which was laggy and unhelpful), only to finally receive a cancellation email stating the rescheduled flight was for 19 Sep at 7:45 PM—making it impossible to travel back in time.

Third-Party Delays: Discovered that Agoda does not issue tickets directly and uses a booking partner instead, which significantly lengthens communication and resolution time.

Final Verdict: A very frustrating and poorly handled experience. I hope you won't have to go through this.

I let them know that I would arrive around 2 PM and wait at the coffee shop nearby. But because we had so much luggage, we decided to wait outside near the sidewalk instead. I was traveling with my husband and my 10-year-old daughter, with six pieces of luggage.

When it was time to check in, no matter how many messages I sent or how many times I called, the host never answered or picked up the phone.

I then contacted Agoda. They told me they had called the host and that the host actually picked up. Agoda even gave me the phone number they had contacted—which was the exact same number I had been calling. I called the host again, but they still didn’t answer.

Agoda then told me they would try contacting the host again, and after that, I never heard back from Agoda either.

I honestly don’t understand. If the host didn’t want to accommodate us, why couldn’t they simply let us know? I would have had time to find another hotel instead of leaving us stranded with my husband, my 10-year-old daughter, and six pieces of luggage.

Absolutely horrible experience and extremely irresponsible behavior.

reviews.title: Junk!!!
reviews.text:
Junk with a capital J!

Trying to locate useful customer service at Agoda is about as easy as removing gallbladder stones through your rectum.

I had several properties contact me after I booked to tell me the room wasn’t actually available. This is especially awesome to find out when you’ve already landed at your destination. Agado offered me credit or a gift for my stress and anxiety. 

One property simply never sent me check-in instructions. It took almost THREE HOURS dealing with customer service—once I finally figured out how to get an actual phone number and speak to a human being. They did refund that transaction, so cheers to Agoda for at least getting that one right.

Then I booked another rental at the exact same property. Shortly afterward, the owner called me and said it never should have been listed because the unit was already occupied. Needless to say, at this point I’m about to snap.

And God forbid you make a mistake with your booking dates—or the app is nice enough to change the dates for you. Kiss that money goodbye, even if you notice the mistake five seconds after booking. The hotel tells you Agoda has to make the change. Agoda tells you the hotel has to make the change. I finally got an email telling me to F off and eat the costs. 

Don’t bother with email support either. It’ll be a cold day in hell before you get a useful response.

They collect their commission, and apparently that’s where the relationship ends.

Stick with Airbnb!

I’d suggest Booking

reviews.title: Unethical practices
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing and unacceptable experience with Agoda

I am extremely disappointed with how Agoda handled my recent hotel booking.

The booking was cancelled on the basis of “non-payment in time.” This explanation is simply not consistent with what happened. I had already made the required payment, and the payment was processed successfully. I therefore expected Agoda to honour the booking or, at the very least, properly investigate the payment status before cancelling it.

What makes this even more concerning is that rooms at the same property were still showing as available until this morning, but at a significantly higher price. From a customer’s perspective, this raises a very serious concern: if payment had genuinely failed or the booking had not been completed in time, why was the room subsequently still available for sale at a higher rate?

I am not making an accusation that Agoda deliberately cancelled my booking to resell the room at a higher price. However, Agoda needs to explain clearly and transparently why this happened, because the circumstances create exactly that impression.

A customer should not make a payment, receive a processed payment confirmation, plan a trip around a confirmed booking, and then have the booking cancelled under a generic “non-payment” explanation — especially when the same room remains available at a higher price.

This is particularly unacceptable because this was a family trip and alternative arrangements now have to be made

I had a very disappointing experience with Agoda’s airline booking service. While the hotel booking service has been good, I was extremely disappointed with how an airline booking name error was handled.

Even though I had submitted the required passport/reference information, Agoda did not take responsibility for the name booking error. I was informed that I had to pay an additional fee to amend the passenger’s name.

It was very frustrating to have to pay extra to correct a booking issue when the relevant passport information had already been provided. The experience left me feeling that Agoda does not provide sufficient support or accountability when problems occur with airline bookings.

Very, very disappointing experience.

reviews.title: Customer service is trash. Id rate a 0 if i could!
reviews.text:
My flight was significantly delayed, which caused me to arrive at the hotel after midnight. Before midnight, I personally called the hotel and informed the hotel staff that my flight was delayed and that I would be arriving late. The hotel staff acknowledged the situation and informed me that they would note the reservation and communicate the information.

Unfortunately, the overnight/night staff was apparently not given this information. When I arrived, I was told that my reservation had been cancelled as a no-show and that the room had already been rebooked to another guest.

I did not abandon or intentionally miss my reservation. I made a good-faith effort to notify the hotel BEFORE midnight and relied on the hotel staff to document and communicate the information.

My wife and 2 kids were turned away. We ended up at a different hotel. The staff there was nice enough to call around other hotels for availability and once no rooms were available, we were allowed to wait in the hotel lobby couch were my kids were able to take a nap until morning. 

Agoda customer service was no help! Refused to help me get a refund for the 1st night that we were turned away and we were forced to stay at another hotel lobby couch!

reviews.title: Double charge
reviews.text:
I booked a hotel through Agoda on 13 July 2024. During the payment process, the Agoda app glitched and I was charged twice for the same hotel booking at the same time.

I contacted Agoda’s customer service several times, but they kept insisting that the hotel had to approve the refund. I do not understand why the responsibility was shifted to the hotel when the duplicate charge was caused by Agoda’s system malfunction.

As the booking platform, Agoda should take full responsibility for investigating and resolving issues caused by its own app. It is unreasonable for customers to bear the consequences of a system glitch that was completely beyond their control.

I chose Agoda instead of booking directly with the hotel because I wanted convenience and a smooth, stress-free start to my holiday. Instead, I have experienced nothing but stress before my trip because Agoda has failed to take responsibility for its own platform error. I am still being held up by Agoda’s refusal to resolve this properly. Based on my experience, I would urge others to think carefully before choosing Agoda.

I am writing this to warn other travelers about Agoda's dishonest business practices and lack of corporate accountability. I booked a Triple Room at the Premiere Classe Boulogne-Saint Martin Les Boulogne through Agoda. The booking checkout screen explicitly promised "Air conditioning" next to my name. reviews.title: ❌ Very Poor Handling of Late Check-in – Family with Infant Left Strande
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this booking through Agoda.

I informed Agoda in advance that my flight (AK720) was delayed and that I would be arriving late. I was travelling with my parents, my wife, and an infant.

When I arrived at the property in the early morning, I was unable to check in. The property did not answer calls, and we were left stranded outside the KLCC area. The Agoda app did not show any cancellation at that time.

I immediately contacted Agoda for assistance and requested help to arrange accommodation for the remaining nights (19–23 Dec), but no alternative arrangement was made. I was forced to book emergency accommodation and then rebook another hotel at my own expense.

Despite this, Agoda later marked the booking as a “no-show” and only refunded SGD 16.55, which is completely unreasonable given that the accommodation was not provided.

Customer service repeatedly asked me to wait, gave no clear resolution, and eventually ended the conversation without resolving the issue.

I am sharing this review to caution other travellers, especially families with infants or elderly parents. Please be very careful if you expect late check-in support or real assistance when problems occur.

reviews.title: Very disappointing and stressful experience with Agoda flight booking.
reviews.text:
I booked a round-trip flight for my family of 5, expecting both segments (SIN → KUL and KUL → SIN) to be issued together. Instead, Agoda’s system only issued the return ticket, and the first segment was never ticketed. This left me with a one-way ticket I never intended to buy, and now the price for the missing one-way segment is much higher.

Despite explaining everything clearly and providing documents, Agoda refused to offer any fair solution. Their system failure became my responsibility, and I spent days chasing replies, dealing with stress, and trying to fix a problem that I did not cause.

This experience shows that Agoda’s flight booking system and policies leave all the risk on the customer. I have used Agoda many times before, but this situation was extremely disappointing. I hope Agoda improves their transparency, booking process, and customer support so other customers do not face the same issue.

When I called customer service, I asked for Spanish since the ones in English I can genuinely barely understand. Like not even trying to be rude. But it’s one of those call centers in India where they don’t know the country you’re visiting - Colombia in my case, and will try to ignore you when you call them. The guy on the phone literally told me to be reasonable when I told him that if the app moved me to a different hotel, then it needs to be one of equal or greater value and rating. Meanwhile they had booked me at a hotel with no air conditioning, and none of the other amenities that I specifically chose the other hotel for. Save yourself the headache and stress. I will NEVER book using this app again and I suggest you don’t either.
